description.value: Sushi Hil is an intimate sushi restaurant in Vancouver's Mt. Pleasant neighbourhood, led by Chef Hilary Nguy, who brings over 20 years of Japanese culinary experience to a menu built around the finest seasonal ingredients. The restaurant holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand designation and ranks at #90 on Canada's 100 Best Restaurants, making it a notable culinary destination on Main Street's 'Michelin Mile.' Cyclists riding through Mt. Pleasant will find a focused, chef-driven menu spanning sashimi, nigiri, makimono, and multi-course sets at lunch and dinner.
